description: REQ-BILL-013 specifies that billing-service must 'immediately persist members.payjp_initial_charge_id and members.initial_charge_paid_at' after the initial charge. The subscribe orchestration in shell/subscribe.ts does pass payjp_initial_charge_id in updateMemberAfterSubscribe (line 230), but initial_charge_paid_at is never set in the subscribe flow. The updateMemberAfterSubscribe signature in shell/types.ts (lines 89-102) does not include initial_charge_paid_at as a parameter. The contract does not call attention to this field. Tests in subscribe-flow.test.ts also never assert that initial_charge_paid_at is set.
remediation: Add initial_charge_paid_at to the updateMemberAfterSubscribe parameter type. Set it to the current timestamp for first-time users in subscribe.ts. Add a test assertion verifying the field is set. Add a contract criterion specifically covering initial_charge_paid_at persistence.
